title: Base change of the constructed finite projective-line trace counit
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring killed by $N>0$, and let $t,d$ be normalized finite-line comparisons and splittings satisfying the splitting-and-trace base-change property [lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals]. Consider a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with horizontal arrows $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, $g:Y\prime\to Y$ and proper compactifiable vertical arrows $q:X\to Y$, $q\prime:X\prime\to Y\prime$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-asd-compactifiable], where $q\prime$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $e:X\cong\mathbf P^1_Y$ and $e\prime:X\prime\cong\mathbf P^1_{Y\prime}$ be presentations over their bases compatible with the horizontal arrow: $e\prime;g_P=g\prime;e$. Suppose $N$ is invertible on both bases. For every unbounded complex $K$ on $Y$, let $c_K:g^{\prime *}G_qK\cong G_{q\prime}g^*K$ and $\varepsilon_q,\varepsilon_{q\prime}$ be the explicit comparisons and counits [def-asd-presented-projective-line-trace-model]. Then $\operatorname{Ex}_{!,G_qK};Rq\prime_!(c_K);\varepsilon_{q\prime,g^*K}=g^*(\varepsilon_{q,K})$, where semicolons denote diagrammatic composition. The counits are concrete inverse-projection trace composites; no adjunction or exceptional inverse-image base-change hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Second paragraph, projective-line computation: trace and projection squares give the counit square.

proof.text: Use the forward ordered projection square [lem-asd-proper-ordered-projection-exchange] and the coefficient trace square [lem-asd-presented-projective-line-coefficient-trace-exchange]. Tensor naturality and the right-unit clause of [lem-asd-finite-twist-derived-evaluation-pullback] prove the tensor-trace square.

Let P be ordered projection followed by inverse proper coincidence. The definition [def-asd-presented-projective-line-trace-model] implies P followed by the constructed counit is tensor trace: cancel proper coincidence and the ordered projection inverse. P is invertible by isIso_finiteP1Projection. Precompose the desired counit equality by g*(P). Substitute the forward projection square, cancel Pprime with its counit, apply the tensor-trace square, and cancel the epimorphism g*(P). This is the Lean calc proof.

theorem presentedFiniteP1Counit_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (d : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t T hT)
    (hbc : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t d)
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} {q : X ⟶ Y} {q' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback g' q' q g)
    [IsProper q] [IsProper q'] [HasCompactification q] [HasCompactification q']
    [QuasiCompact q']
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine Y) (w : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) = q)
    (e' : X' ≅ ProjectiveLine Y') (w' : e'.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine Y' ↘ Y') = q')
    (we : e'.hom ≫ ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) g = g' ≫ e.hom)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hY' : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y', ⊤)))
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app
        ((ordinaryFiniteTwistedPullback A q
          ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)).obj K) ≫
      (R(q')_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        (finiteP1TwistedPullbackComparison A N hA t sq hY K).hom ≫
      (presentedFiniteP1Counit A N hA t q' e' w' hY' (d Y' hY')).app
        ((L((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).obj K) =
    (L((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).map
      ((presentedFiniteP1Counit A N hA t q e w hY (d Y hY)).app K)
